anchors.source_context_30_lines:
50: **Unifying theme**: After perturbative exhaustion, the project searched for non-perturbative or beyond-Jensen escape routes. The Kosmann-BCS attempt (the "Venus moment" of S23a) revealed that the spectral gap (W3) prevents BCS at mu=0. The V_spec monotonicity was extended to all cutoff parameters, the full U(2)-invariant moduli surface, and the Freund-Rubin 3-form sector. Particle-hole symmetry closed both canonical and grand canonical finite-density approaches. Every static mechanism operating on any accessible piece of the moduli space was eliminated.
